system.description:
Grabbing ahold of your weapon and infusing it with your chakra allows you to make shots that make follow up shots have the luck of Hittite. For the duration, each time you roll an Ammunition Die as part of a Taijutsu attack, you can choose to instead reduce the size of your ammunition die by 1 step. If you do, the affected creature that you deal [Weapon damage] to becomes Fortune-Marked until the end of your next turn.

| Rundas Ammo – Fortune-Marked / A Creature that is Fortune-Marked radiates with a soft orange mist that only the creature that inflicted the mark can see. Any creature of your choice that attacks a Fortune-Marked creature and misses can trigger the mark, allowing them remake their attack. This causes the mark to end early. |
